VisitorPass.title: VisitorPass
VisitorPass.description: Represents a visitor pass for the AyushConclave- Arogya Expo.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Visitor Pass.

name.description: The full name of the visitor.

number.description: The phone number of the visitor.

mailId.description: The email address of the visitor.

registrationDate.description: The date and time the visitor pass was registered.

definition.description: Stores visitor pass information. Accessible only to admins.  Includes fields for name, number, mailId, location, and registrationDate.

params.name: visitorPassId
params.description: Unique identifier for the visitor pass.

definition.description: Documents in this collection indicate admin status.  The existence of a document with the user's UID grants admin privileges.

params.name: uid
params.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the potential admin.

firestore.reasoning: This design prioritizes security and scalability for the AyushConclave-Arogya Expo visitor pass management. It leverages Structural Segregation and Access Modeling to ensure clear authorization and efficient queries. A dedicated collection, `/visitor_passes`, stores all visitor pass data. Admins are managed via an `/admin_roles/{uid}` collection, using Existence over Content. This design eliminates the need for complex rules or `get()` calls in security rules, enhancing performance and security.  The structure enables secure `list` operations (QAPs) by limiting read access to authorized admins through path-based rules on the `/visitor_passes` collection and the `/admin_roles/{uid}` collection.
